interpret_reference_object: interpret a dialogue dict to find matching reference object memories by filters and special references
interpret_schematic: parse a shape or named schematic dict into a list of block tuples and tags
interpret_reference_location: resolve a location dict to reference object memories and update recent entities
interpret_facing: parse yaw, pitch, or relative direction dicts into head rotation or xyz target values
filter_by_sublocation: filter candidate object tuples by proximity, relative direction, or speaker look constraints
